title: WRKY transcription factors: evolution, regulation, and functional diversity in plants.
authors: Goyal, Pooja; Devi, Ritu; Verma, Bhawana; Hussain, Shahnawaz; Arora, Palak; Tabassum, Rubeena; Gupta, Suphla
one_liner_zh: 综述WRKY转录因子的进化、调控与功能多样性，并提及通过同源建模和分子动力学模拟解析DNA-蛋白复合物，但以综述为主、缺乏核心互作建模方法创新。
abstract: The recent advancements in sequencing technologies and informatic tools promoted a paradigm shift to decipher the hidden biological mysteries and transformed the biological issues into digital data to express both qualitative and quantitative forms. The transcriptomic approach, in particular, has added new dimensions to the versatile essence of plant genomics through the large and deep transcripts generated in the process. This has enabled the mining of super families from the sequenced plants, both model and non-model, understanding their ancestry, diversity, and evolution. The elucidation of the crystal structure of the WRKY proteins and recent advancement in computational prediction through homology modeling and molecular dynamic simulation has provided an insight into the DNA-protein complex formation, stability, and interaction, thereby giving a new dimension in understanding the WRKY regulation. The present review summarizes the functional aspects of the high volume of sequence data of WRKY transcription factors studied from different species, till date. The review focuses on the dynamics of structural classification and lineage in light of the recent information. Additionally, a comparative analysis approach was incorporated to understand the functions of the identified WRKY transcription factors subjected to abiotic (heat, cold, salinity, senescence, dark, wounding, UV, and carbon starvation) stresses as revealed through various sets of studies on different plant species. The review will be instrumental in understanding the events of evolution and the importance of WRKY TFs under the threat of climate change, considering the new scientific evidences to propose a fresh perspective.
abstract_zh: 测序技术和信息学工具的最新进展推动了破解隐藏生物学奥秘的范式转变，将生物学问题转化为数字数据，以表达定性和定量形式。特别是转录组学方法，通过过程中产生的大量且深入的转录本，为植物基因组学的多面性本质增添了新的维度。这使得从已测序植物（包括模式和非模式植物）中挖掘超家族成为可能，从而理解它们的祖先、多样性和进化。WRKY蛋白晶体结构的阐明，以及通过同源建模和分子动力学模拟在计算预测方面的最新进展，为DNA-蛋白质复合物的形成、稳定性和相互作用提供了见解，从而为理解WRKY调控开辟了新维度。本综述总结了迄今为止从不同物种中研究的WRKY转录因子大量序列数据的功能方面。综述聚焦于结构分类和谱系动态，结合最新信息。此外，采用比较分析方法，以理解在不同植物物种的多项研究中揭示的、受非生物胁迫（热、冷、盐度、衰老、黑暗、创伤、紫外线和碳饥饿）影响的已鉴定WRKY转录因子的功能。鉴于气候变化威胁，本综述将有助于理解进化事件及WRKY转录因子的重要性，并依据新的科学证据提出新视角。
